behavior_differences.after: soup_cache_send_response() no longer sets Age HTTP header. The code block that called soup_message_headers_replace("Age", ...) has been completely removed.
behavior_differences.evidence: Source diff in soup-cache.c: lines 704-716 deleted (Age header setting code); gcov confirms all surrounding lines 701, 704, 707, 708 are executed (10x hits each)
